candidates.change_summary: Replace oracle() to return address(0) as IOracleProvider when stored oracle is zero address (previously would return IOracleProvider(address(0))); changes returned value when underlying storage is zero address.
Return the stored payoffDefinition directly without reading from storage (skips transform), causing payoffDefinition() to return raw stored bytes instead of the transformed value.
Return a copy of stored payoffDefinition but with its data zeroed, so payoffDefinition() returns same metadata but cleared data bytes.
Change currentVersion() to return oracle().currentVersion() directly (i.e., remove the payoff transform) so returned price is untransformed.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function currentVersion() public view returns (IOracleProvider.OracleVersion memory) { return oracle().currentVersion(); }

candidates.change_summary: Change currentVersion() to return a transformed version using payoffDefinition.transform but apply transform to a zero price (always returns price transformed from zero) instead of oracle price.
Change currentVersion() to fetch oracle currentVersion and then overwrite timestamp to zero before transforming and returning, altering returned timestamp.
Changed atVersion to return the oracle provider's raw atVersion without transforming the price (removed the call to _transform on the returned OracleVersion).
Change the name() declaration to return a fixed literal string instead of the interface declaration (modifying the unit body to a concrete implementation that returns a different value).
Change IProduct.symbol() to return a constant different string to make externally visible symbol() calls return a different value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return "MUTANT_SYMBOL"; }

candidates.change_summary: Return a zero address cast to IController instead of reading stored controller address, so controller() always returns address(0).
Change maintenance() to return controller().minCollateral() instead of stored _maintenance value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function maintenance() public view returns (UFixed18) { return controller().minCollateral(); }

candidates.change_summary: Return controller().minFundingFee() instead of the stored _fundingFee, changing observed fundingFee value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code:
UFixed18Storage private constant _fundingFee = UFixed18Storage.wrap(keccak256("equilibria.perennial.UParamProvider.fundingFee"));
function fundingFee() public view returns (UFixed18) { return controller().minFundingFee(); }

candidates.change_summary: Return a different storage slot (_takerFee) instead of _makerFee, causing makerFee() to return takerFee value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function makerFee() public view returns (UFixed18) { return _takerFee.read(); }

candidates.change_summary: Return stored taker fee as before but convert to a different wrapped type by reading _takerFee and adding ZERO (no-op) replaced with returning double the stored taker fee to change observable value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function takerFee() public view returns (UFixed18) { return _takerFee.read().add(_takerFee.read()); }
